user_query: I'm looking for a specific product and I want to compare its prices and customer reviews from different websites. Can you fetch the product details and comments from multiple websites and display them for me? Additionally, I would like to see screenshots of the product pages to get a visual representation.

TaskList.description: Fetch product details, prices, and customer reviews from multiple e-commerce websites.
Aggregate and filter the fetched product details and reviews for comparison.
Take screenshots of the product pages from the e-commerce websites.
Compile the comparison data and screenshots into a presentable format.
